our_interpretation: The antecedent means a substantial failure or definitive refusal by the two companies to meet the referenced compute obligations. It does not mean that all future commitments are already payable.
The plain reading of 'the jig is up' is a broad and sustained collapse in commercially funded AI data center demand, not merely slower growth or a decline at one supplier.
The supplied words do not identify the accounting basis or contractual composition of the $1.3 trillion.

criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent is established, comparable sector data show demand remaining substantial and sustained despite the labs' nonpayment. Conditions before the antecedent cannot contradict this forecast.
